parameters.name: AliyunLang
parameters.description: The language. Valid values: zh and en. Default: zh.

parameters.name: CreateAuthToken
parameters.description: Whether to create an authentication token for enhanced data security.

parameters.name: EnvironmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the environment instance.

parameters.name: ManagedType
parameters.description:
The agent management mode. Valid values:

- none: unmanaged. Default for ACK clusters.

- agent: managed agents only. Default for ASK, ACS, and ACK One clusters.

- agent-exproter: managed agents and exporters. Default for cloud services.
